items.question: What is Skillpedia?
items.answer: Skillpedia is an open-source project that gathers skill docs scattered across GitHub repositories and provides them in a structured form.

items.question: What is a skill?
items.answer: A guide written by engineers so that AI agents can use a tool correctly. It follows the open standard published by agentskills.io, and each skill lives in a SKILL.md file in a repository.

items.question: Which tools use skills?
items.answer: SKILL.md is not a single product's format but an open standard that many AI agents share. See the list of tools that use the standard at agentskills.io/clients.

items.question: How does Skillpedia fetch skill docs?
items.answer: Each time you open a document, Skillpedia fetches the skill file from the default branch of its GitHub repository. The repository list on the home page refreshes every hour.

Footer.footnote: Skillpedia is an unofficial project run by an individual. Its purpose is to collect SKILL.md files scattered across GitHub repositories and provide them as structured documentation. It helps developers read skill docs written by engineers and understand exactly how to use them. For an AI agent to use a tool correctly, it needs a verified guide written by engineers. Skillpedia is the channel that delivers that guide most efficiently.
